# Generated file layouts

Keep headings exactly; omit a bullet when there is no evidence. `<>` = fill from facts/exemplars.

## house-style.instructions.md
```markdown
---
applyTo: "**"
description: Workspace-wide house style learned by /mule-init from human-written code before <cutoff>. Generated — edit only Overrides.
---
# House style — workspace
Learned <date> from <n> projects, files unchanged since <cutoff>. Precedence: Overrides > this file > shipped defaults. Inside an existing file, that file's style wins.

## Language and text
- Artifacts (code text, comments, docs, commits) in <language> [evidence].
- Comments: <MUST none | rare: <n>/100 lines, only <where>> [evidence].

## Naming
- Projects: `<prefix>-<name>-<layer>`; layers <eapi/papi/sapi> = experience/process/system [evidence].

## Files
- Final newline: <xml/dwl/yaml policy> [evidence].

## Git (only when the user asks for a commit/branch)
- Subject: `<template, e.g. #<id> - <Sentence>>`; real samples: "<s1>", "<s2>", "<s3>" [evidence].
- Branches: `<prefix>/<id>`; base branch `<qa|develop|main>` [evidence].

## Overrides
<!-- Team edits here survive /mule-init. -->
```

## house-style-mule-xml.instructions.md
Sections: `Layout` (indent, attribute-per-line, self-closing form, quotes, xml declaration, blank lines), `Naming` (flow/sub-flow names with samples, doc:name casing with samples, file names, globals/error-handler file names), `Transforms` (external vs inline, folder), `Logging` (exact logger shape copied from exemplar, levels, category), `Outbound` (sendCorrelationId usage, retry placement by layer), `Errors` (dominant constructs and where they appear), `Overrides`.

## house-style-dataweave.instructions.md
Sections: `Header` (exact first lines: `%dw 2.0`, output directive string incl. option spelling e.g. `skipNullOn="everywhere"`, `---`), `Layout` (indent, object `key: value` spacing, `if (` spacing, quotes), `Naming` (file name pattern + folder, var/fun case), `Idioms` (common imports, null handling style), `Overrides`.

## house-style-config.instructions.md
Sections: `Files` (location, env names list, test file), `Keys` (nested vs dotted, key case, indent), `Values` (quoting, secret placeholder literal, booleans/numbers quoting), `Overrides`.

## house-style-munit.instructions.md
Sections: `Suites` (file suffix, one per resource), `Tests` (name pattern with samples), `Mocks & entry` (doc:name selector share, flow-ref entry share), `Fixtures` (dirs, loader function), `Overrides`.

## house-style-docs.instructions.md
Sections: `Language & tone`, `Structure` (heading style samples, bullets char, tables, mermaid), `README skeleton` (heading list copied from exemplar), `Overrides`.

## profile.md

Generated by /mule-init <date> (cutoff <cutoff>). Facts only; conventions live in house-style files.

## Layout
- Root: <path>; Mule projects: <n>; each project its own git repo: <yes/no>; git host: <azure devops/github/...>.

- Anypoint control plane: <https://anypoint.mulesoft.com | https://eu1.anypoint.mulesoft.com> (from Exchange repository URL in pom/settings).
- groupId <g>; parent POM <artifact:version (share)>; runtime/plugin versions <...>; archetype <path or none>; terraform <paths>.

## Build & test
- JDK: <path/version or UNKNOWN>.
- Build: `<cmd>`; Test: `<cmd>`; single test: `<cmd>`; `mule.key` for tests: `<value>`.

## Config
- Location <...>; env names <list> (variants: <e.g. -ot set>); secret placeholder `<literal>`; secure prefix `<secure::>`.

## Conventions confirmed elsewhere
- Global error handler file <name>; error DWL <path>; shared library <name>.
- Decisions imported from earlier harness: <dated one-liners>.
